items.name: Binary-Scaling-and-the-Accelerated-Collatz-Map
items.description: This paper maps where Collatz facts end and guesses begin. It doesn't solve it. It maps a razor-thin aperiodic corridor where rogue numbers could theoretically escape. It proves the global mystery is just a static math target called L(r). With its core certified in Lean 4, it gives a perfect blueprint for a real proof.
